articles.title: OPENAI EMPLOYEE ARRESTED OVER HIDDEN RECORDING DEVICE
articles.summary: OpenAI said it alerted the FBI after finding a hidden recording device in an executive conference room, leading to the firing and arrest of employee Abdulrahman Alfozan. Prosecutors alleged the device was used to covertly intercept conversations, while OpenAI said it found no evidence that model weights, source code, or customer data were accessed.

articles.title: GEMINI 4 ARGON LANDS ON GOOGLE CLOUD
articles.summary: Google made Gemini 4 Argon available on Google Cloud as a frontier model for long, multi-step enterprise work. It was positioned for tasks requiring sustained context and domain expertise, including software development, finance, legal work, and cybersecurity.

articles.title: ARGUMENTS ABOUT AI CONSCIOUSNESS REMAIN HIGHLY MOTIVATED AND AT BEST OVERCONFIDENT
articles.summary: The debate over AI consciousness continues with minimal progress, as many argue without strong evidence. Anthropic's new policy classifies abusive behavior towards AI, such as Claude, as a violation of terms to cultivate positive model interactions. Despite skepticism from many, some, including Nick Bostrom, believe current AIs may be conscious, complicating ethical considerations around AI development.

articles.title: HOW ANTHROPIC'S DYNAMIC WORKFLOWS COORDINATE CLAUDE AGENTS
articles.summary: Splitting a task among several AI agents creates another job: deciding who does what, passing information between them, and checking their results. Anthropic's dynamic workflows let Claude write the program that manages those steps. An October 12 demonstration assigned stock tickers to separate agents, then reviewed their findings before producing a report. The presenters said this found more detail but cost much more than using one agent. Developers can set a session spending limit, but the running model does not know that budget.

articles.title: NVIDIA RUN:AI IS NOW OPEN SOURCE AS PART OF NVIDIA DSX AI FACTORY PLATFORM
articles.summary: Nvidia is making the full NVIDIA Run:ai platform available as open-source software. It is now possible for every NVIDIA DSX ecosystem partner and AI cloud to increase workload throughput, improve GPU utilization, and operate shared AI infrastructure more efficiently and effectively. The release includes the complete NVIDIA Run:ai platform, KAI Scheduler, GPU Fractioning Operator, KAI Resource Management, and Workload Map. Platform teams and ecosystem partners can adopt NVIDIA Run:ai as an integrated whole, build on it for their own products and services, or integrate individual components based on their requirements.

articles.title: FRONTIER MODELS FOR EVERY ROBOT
articles.summary: Physical Intelligence is making its latest models available for training and inference through the Pi API beta. The Pi API adapts the latest and most powerful robotic foundation models to each application, dealing with ML infrastructure, compute, and complex data pipelines. Users just upload data, launch fine-tuning on managed compute and infrastructure, and access the fine-tuned models via a hosted gateway to run inference.

articles.title: LFM2.5-24B-A2B
articles.summary: LFM2.5-24B-A2B, a 24B-parameter reasoning model with 2B active parameters, is designed for fast, private on-device agents. It outperforms or matches larger models like Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on five out of eight benchmarks and runs up to 1.7x faster due to its efficient architecture. Available on Hugging Face, it supports extensive inference frameworks, making it suitable for tasks needing swift local inference and tool usage.

articles.title: OPENCODE 2.0
articles.summary: OpenCode 2.0 contains quite a lot of new features, performance improvements, and bug fixes. The server now automatically runs as a single background process. Programmatic clients will autodiscover the local service and just work. OpenCode can now be used as a library with the SDK package. More details about the update are available in the article.

articles.title: CHARACTER.AI FILED FOR CHAPTER 11 BANKRUPTCY
articles.summary: Character.ai initiated a voluntary Chapter 11 bankruptcy process to pursue a court-supervised sale after facing legal, regulatory, and operational pressures. The company said the platform could continue under a successful bid, but may be wound down if no viable buyer emerges.

articles.title: RAMP GLASS
articles.summary: Ramp has launched Glass, an AI workspace that shares company knowledge, reusable skills, and collaborative sessions across teams. Employees have made 6,500+ knowledge edits, while model routing cut AI costs by 30% and automated workflows dramatically expanded feature-request tracking.
